milestone.title: mp watch deprecation — issue a deprecation warning when the legacy alias is invoked

intent.outcome: `mp watch` continues to function (A2 ships the alias) but prints a deprecation warning to stderr on every invocation pointing the user at `mp autopilot`; the warning is non-blocking and survives shell pipelines; after the consumer-surface hygiene sweep (F3), `mp watch` is removed entirely.

problem.description: A2 pivots `mp watch` to a thin alias of `mp autopilot`. Without a deprecation notice, users (and CI pipelines) keep invoking the old name silently. After one release of notice, F3 removes the alias. The notice must be visible but not blocking — exit code, stdout, and pipelines all keep working; only stderr gains a one-line warning.

in_scope: Add a deprecation hook in the alias layer (clap-level `alias` callback) that prints `mp watch is deprecated; use 'mp autopilot' instead.` to stderr.
Make sure the deprecation message is emitted ONCE per invocation (not once per subcommand — for `mp watch status` style invocations, only the top-level triggers the message).
Survive pipelines: stderr-only; do not corrupt stdout JSON (the new `mp autopilot` output is unchanged).
Document the deprecation timeline (one release notice, then removal under F3) in `docs/autopilot/migration.md`.
out_of_scope: Removing `mp watch` — that's a follow-up after F3 lands and consumers have migrated.
Adding a 'show what's new' message — kept simple: one line, one language.
Telemetry / opt-in stats on `mp watch` usage — not needed for the deprecation itself.

acceptance_criteria.description: Invoking `mp watch --help`, `mp watch status`, or `mp autopilot status` (after the legacy alias was used) prints the documented deprecation warning to stderr and produces no change to stdout.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: ran `mp watch --help 2>stderr.log 1>stdout.log`; confirmed the warning appears in stderr.log and stdout.log contains only the help text.

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp autopilot --help` (the canonical name) does NOT print the deprecation warning.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: ran `mp autopilot --help 2>stderr.log`; confirmed stderr.log is empty.

acceptance_criteria.description: The deprecation message text matches the documented string (`mp watch is deprecated; use 'mp autopilot' instead.`) byte-for-byte.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; verifier allows manual ACs in draft state. Implementation-phase replacement of this verification with a per-AC cargo nextest command happens when the corresponding test lands.

design_decisions.choice: stderr only, single line, no color (works in non-tty contexts and CI logs).
design_decisions.rationale: Stdout is reserved for the actual command output (especially JSON when `--format json`); stderr is the conventional deprecation channel.

design_decisions.choice: Emit once per invocation (not once per subcommand or per session). Avoid spammy warnings on long-running polling.
design_decisions.rationale: Long sessions shouldn't generate 1 warning per status call.
